summary: Alli Summerford was the 2018 Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 48, covering parts of Jefferson and Shelby counties. She is a Mountain Brook resident who founded a web-design and digital-marketing business operated for roughly two decades. Her educational background includes a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee and an MBA focused on new-venture analysis. Prior to her candidacy, she reported civic work including service on a women's shelter board, library support, Rotary exchange service, and founding a local track-club booster organization.
